name: Should I choose ceramic or porcelain tile for my bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose ceramic or porcelain tile for my bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both ceramic and porcelain tiles are popular for bathrooms, but porcelain generally offers superior performance. Porcelain is denser, less porous, and more durable than ceramic, making it highly resistant to water absorption, stains, and wear. This makes porcelain ideal for high-traffic areas and shower enclosures. Ceramic tile is often more affordable and easier to cut, offering a wider range of design options. For a balance of cost and durability, ceramic can be suitable for lighter-use areas, while porcelain provides maximum longevity and moisture protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is denser, more durable, and less porous than ceramic, making it better for high-traffic and wet areas. Ceramic is more affordable and has wider design options.
